symptom: `describe snippet` printed a data view sourced from a snippet parameter (`dataview dv (DataSource: $Parent)` inside `Params: ($Parent: …)`) with no DataSource; re-executing the output stored SourceVariable: null and mx check failed CE0488 "No entity configured for the data source of this data view".
cause: parseContextSource (cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go) read only SourceVariable.PageParameter. Inside a snippet the name lives in the SnippetParameter slot with PageParameter empty. The association-source reader beside it (associationSourcePath, #721 L3) and the pluggable reader already fell back to SnippetParameter; this was the one copy that did not.
fix: parseContextSource falls back to SourceVariable.SnippetParameter and returns the same `parameter` source.
insight: A slot-pair bug fixed in one reader is a list of every reader of that BSON field: `grep -rn '\["PageParameter"\]' mdl/` finds four, and one had been missed. The decisive check is a round trip, not the describe text: exec the describe output on a copy and mx check it. Here the old output gave CE0488 and the fixed output gave 'Unchanged snippet' (write elided) and 0 errors. Found by eye while dumping BSON for an unrelated issue (#1379): the stored data view had SnippetParameter set but the describe text showed no source.
